storylines: CASEY: I still think this team is building toward something. I know what the record says. GORD: The record says zero and five and one. CASEY: And seven games left to turn it around. Friday, October sixteenth, six-thirty PM, away against the Puckin Clowns. We'll find out if Darren carries it forward or I start owing Gord an apology. GORD: I'll be ready either way.
